orientation_anchor: lambda * geodesic(R,R_initial)^2, radians squared, stable atan2
legacy_prior: Preserve original 0.1 * mean((all_16_rotation_matrices - initial)^2). Explicit legacy prior; new orientation anchor is SO(3), not matrix MSE. In B9 this legacy prior only penalizes articulated rotations.
reprojection: original per-view normalized loss with 3px scale; no GT observations
timing: new runs instantiate MANO only, no teacher; reused runtime remains historical, resident-memory scopes differ
selection: zero numerical/depth failures; quality <=1/32; abs mean <=12mm and wrist-relative mean <=8mm; prefer B2 if eligible; otherwise report Pareto frontier when no joint-feasible solution
